title: Landing-page selection policy (policy.json) v1
description: Declarative, Helios-authored, locally-evaluated selection policy (parent EPIC_PLAN §6). Output biases the per-NUM weighting on the canonical /SITE/PURPOSE/SLUG/NUM schema; it never emits a new URL shape. The evaluator must be free of impure nondeterminism (CEL, no eval); randomized scatter is supplied as a deterministic HMAC bucket input.

selection_algorithm_version.description: Logged on every event so off-policy/propensity estimates stay comparable (parent §6/§8).

match.description: Context predicate. At least one of site/family/cluster_slug must be present.

assignment_key.description: Ordered context fields that compose the per-click assignment key fed to the HMAC bucket (parent §6).

experiment_id.description: Stable experiment identity. experiment_salt is tied to this, NOT to bundle_id, so routine republishes do not reshuffle in-flight clicks.

exploration_rate_bps.description: Fraction (basis points) of clicks routed to the explore set vs. the exploit champion.

slots.description: Keyed by slot id (X1, X2, ...). Each slot is exactly one of: exploit/explore (variant pick), fixed (frozen component), or data_source (data-driven, e.g. Sweed).

exploit.description: Champion variant id served outside the exploration fraction.

explore.description: Weighted exploration candidates. Empty/omitted = pure exploit.

fixed.description: Frozen component id (e.g. the X2 trust anchor).
